mentions.name: LongHorizon
mentions.description: A platform that lets developers do test planning and testing automation using their coding agents. Testing session records are shareable and can be added to PRs, giving reviewers visibility into how a feature works, which scenarios were handled and tested, and what might have been missed.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have been building https://longhorizon.dev

It let's developer do test planning and testing automation using their coding agents. The records of the testing sessions are then shareable and can be added to PRs, giving the reviewers visibility into how the feature works, what scenarios are handled and tested and what might have been missed.
